invariants.rationale: orders is checked for null at method entry before proceeding to main logic; for any non-zero result, orders must not be null.
Method returns immediately if orders is null or empty, so if method runs main logic, orders is non-empty.
Total price sums non-negative order prices after optional discount; negative totals should not arise.
Only returns zero if orders is null or empty; if not, result must be sum of processed prices.
If orders is non-null and non-empty, at least one order price is summed and discounted as needed, making result positive.
